No honeycomb, chainmail, holes, rings, bubbles, cobblestone-like soil, outlined circles, glitter dots, repetitive scales, embossed texture or evenly spaced pebbles. Make actual readable dirt and low grass instead. Render genuine fine detail, not an enlarged blurry texture or sharpening halos.
